To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
EA quality is an important factor for the success of an EA program, and that EA quality can be increased by focusing on ten quality attributes.

EA quality attributes are: 1) a prerequisite for realizing the benefits of EA; 2) an enabler of EA success; 3) the result of the EA process; 4) an outcome of EA; 5) a quality attribute of EA products and services; 6) a measure of EA quality; 7) a means of evaluating EA products and services.

the quality attributes that increase EA product quality are: (i) the quality attributes that EA products should possess are: comprehensiveness, consistency, completeness, correctness, flexibility, and reusability, (ii) the quality attributes of EA products should be evaluated by: the EA team, business management, IT management, and EA customers, and (iii) the quality attributes which should be used to evaluate EA services are: comprehensibility, consistency, correctness, and flexibility.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying and describing the quality attributes of EA products and services.
the question: "How can we ensure the quality of EA products and services?".
the following research question: What are the quality attributes of enterprise architecture products and services?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the quality of EA products and services should be considered in the context of EA maturity, and that the quality of the EA product and the EA service are interrelated.
EA quality is an important aspect of EA, and that the identified EA quality attributes are a good starting point for further research.
the quality attributes for EA are: completeness, correctness, consistency, comprehensibility, adaptability, re-usability, maintainability, flexibility, reliability and security.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified and described a set of EA quality attributes that can be utilized to assess EA products and services.
EA quality is a prerequisite for EA to realize its full potential, and that EA quality is dependent on the context in which the EA product or service is used.

EA quality can be increased by focusing on the following attributes: (1) alignment, (2) consistency, (3) completeness, (4) accuracy, (5) relevance, (6) comprehensibility, (7) usability, (8) flexibility, (9) maintainability, and (10) traceability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
EA is a quality product and should be managed as such.
EA quality attributes are a prerequisite for the success of EA, and that EA practitioners should consider them when developing and using EA products and services.
EA quality can be increased by focusing on the quality of the EA products and services themselves, and by paying special attention to the EA processes that are used to produce them.
